notes: Overview: large legacy media/content archive (audio/video transcripts, magazine articles, legal briefs). Primary goal: fast, high-recall enterprise search for newsroom and legal teams.
Corpus estimate: ~30M long-form items (avg 4k-8k tokens). Expected chunk count after strategy: ~150M - 200M chunks (512-1024 token chunks with overlap).
Performance targets: P95 end-to-end search latency <= 200-250ms for interactive queries; cost per query target <= $0.01 (ideally $0.005) at 1k-5k QPS sustained bursts to 10k QPS.

POC summary (Feb-Mar): ingested 100k articles + 40k transcripts. Baseline ANN retrieval (faiss/pinecone) + bi-encoder embeddings recall@10 = 0.78. Adding a cross-encoder reranker (GPU) improved MRR by ~12% but increased latency to ~420-480ms.

Chunking strategy discussion: team prefers mixed chunk sizes — 512 token chunks for dense retrieval speed, 1024 token chunks for semantic context retention on long transcripts. Proposed sliding window overlap 20-30% to preserve phrase continuity for reranker.

Reranker tuning notes: two-stage pipeline recommended: dense ANN (k=200) -> lightweight distilled cross-encoder reranker (k=10). Evaluate distillation to get <250ms P95 on CPU, or GPU micro-batching for peak loads. Consider pairwise loss fine-tune on labeled relevance set from editor judgments.

Embedding model preferences: open / quantization-friendly embeddings (sbert-like) to control cost. Want vendor-agnostic model options; trial with Redwood-verified embedding profiles before committing to dedicated capacity.

Indexing scale concerns: storage of 150M vectors + metadata estimated at 12-18TB depending on float16/8-bit quantization. Need recommendations on sharding, cold/hot tiering, and prefix caching for top queries.

Cost modeling asks: provide breakdown per-token embedding cost, ANN cost (storage + query), reranker GPU-second cost and amortized per-query estimates for 1k/5k/10k QPS. Finance needs 3-year TCO for hosted vs dedicated vs private.

Security/compliance: must meet SSO/SAML, audit logs retained 1 year, KMS integration for keys, data residency in NA/EU. Legal flagged air-gapped option for some regulated clients — exploring Redwood Private on-prem offering.
Direct quote (VP Product): 'We need sub-250ms for customer-facing search — editors cannot tolerate slow responses. If reranker costs blow up latency, it's a no-go.'

Technical asks from SE session: 1) recommended chunk size tradeoffs with sample runtime numbers, 2) reranker config templates (k values, batch sizes, GPU configs), 3) caching + prefix/KV suggestions for trending articles, 4) fallback policy templates (use bi-encoder-only if cross-encoder unavailable).
